title: TC001-Open the landing page and access staff sign-in
description: This verifies that a visitor can view the public landing page and continue to the staff login page from the main call to action.
code:
import asyncio
import re
from playwright import async_api
from playwright.async_api import expect

async def run_test():
    pw = None
    browser = None
    context = None

    try:
        # Start a Playwright session in asynchronous mode
        pw = await async_api.async_playwright().start()

        # Launch a Chromium browser in headless mode with custom arguments
        browser = await pw.chromium.launch(
            headless=True,
            args=[
                "--window-size=1280,720",
                "--disable-dev-shm-usage",
                "--ipc=host",
                "--single-process"
            ],
        )

        # Create a new browser context (like an incognito window)
        context = await browser.new_context()
        # Wider default timeout to match the agent's DOM-stability budget;
        # auto-waiting Playwright APIs (expect, locator.wait_for) inherit this.
        context.set_default_timeout(15000)

        # Open a new page in the browser context
        page = await context.new_page()

        # Interact with the page elements to simulate user flow
        # -> navigate
        await page.goto("http://localhost:8000")
        try:
            await page.wait_for_load_state("domcontentloaded", timeout=5000)
        except Exception:
            pass
        
        # -> Click the 'Masuk' (Login) button in the page header to navigate to the staff sign-in page and then verify the login form is displayed.
        # Masuk link
        elem = page.get_by_text('Coba gratis', exact=True).locator("xpath=ancestor-or-self::*[.//a][1]").get_by_role('link', name='Masuk', exact=True)
        await elem.click(timeout=10000)
        
        # --> Assertions to verify final state
        
        # --> Verify the platform overview content is displayed
        # Assert: The platform brand 'Pesantren.online' is visible on the page.
        await expect(page.locator("xpath=/html/body/div[1]/div/main/div/div[1]/header/div/div/span[1]").nth(0)).to_contain_text("Pesantren.online", timeout=15000), "The platform brand 'Pesantren.online' is visible on the page."
        await page.locator("xpath=/html/body/div[1]/div/main/div/div[1]/header/div/div/span[1]/svg").nth(0).scroll_into_view_if_needed()
        # Assert: The platform logo SVG is visible on the page.
        await expect(page.locator("xpath=/html/body/div[1]/div/main/div/div[1]/header/div/div/span[1]/svg").nth(0)).to_be_visible(timeout=15000), "The platform logo SVG is visible on the page."
        
        # --> Verify the staff sign-in page is displayed
        await page.locator("xpath=/html/body/div[1]/div/main/div/div[1]/div/div[1]/div/form/div[1]/div/div/div/div[1]/div/div/div[2]/div/div/input").nth(0).scroll_into_view_if_needed()
        # Assert: The Email address input field is visible on the staff sign-in page.
        await expect(page.locator("xpath=/html/body/div[1]/div/main/div/div[1]/div/div[1]/div/form/div[1]/div/div/div/div[1]/div/div/div[2]/div/div/input").nth(0)).to_be_visible(timeout=15000), "The Email address input field is visible on the staff sign-in page."
        await page.locator("xpath=/html/body/div[1]/div/main/div/div[1]/div/div[1]/div/form/div[1]/div/div/div/div[2]/div/div/div[2]/div/div[1]/input").nth(0).scroll_into_view_if_needed()
        # Assert: The Password input field is visible on the staff sign-in page.
        await expect(page.locator("xpath=/html/body/div[1]/div/main/div/div[1]/div/div[1]/div/form/div[1]/div/div/div/div[2]/div/div/div[2]/div/div[1]/input").nth(0)).to_be_visible(timeout=15000), "The Password input field is visible on the staff sign-in page."
        await page.locator("xpath=/html/body/div[1]/div/main/div/div[1]/div/div[1]/div/form/div[2]/div/div/div/div/button").nth(0).scroll_into_view_if_needed()
        # Assert: The 'Sign in' submit button is visible on the staff sign-in page.
        await expect(page.locator("xpath=/html/body/div[1]/div/main/div/div[1]/div/div[1]/div/form/div[2]/div/div/div/div/button").nth(0)).to_be_visible(timeout=15000), "The 'Sign in' submit button is visible on the staff sign-in page."
        await page.locator("xpath=/html/body/div[1]/div/main/div/div[1]/div/div[1]/div/form/div[1]/div/div/div/div[2]/div/div/div[1]/div/div/div/div/span/a").nth(0).scroll_into_view_if_needed()
        # Assert: The 'Forgot password?' link is visible on the staff sign-in page.
        await expect(page.locator("xpath=/html/body/div[1]/div/main/div/div[1]/div/div[1]/div/form/div[1]/div/div/div/div[2]/div/div/div[1]/div/div/div/div/span/a").nth(0)).to_be_visible(timeout=15000), "The 'Forgot password?' link is visible on the staff sign-in page."
        await asyncio.sleep(5)

    finally:
        if context:
            await context.close()
        if browser:
            await browser.close()
        if pw:
            await pw.stop()

asyncio.run(run_test())

title: TC002-Read the privacy policy and return to the landing page
description: This verifies that a public visitor can open the privacy policy page, read the static content, and return to the landing page.
code:

import re
from playwright import async_api
from playwright.async_api import expect

async def run_test():
    pw = None
    browser = None
    context = None

    try:
        # Start a Playwright session in asynchronous mode
        pw = await async_api.async_playwright().start()

        # Launch a Chromium browser in headless mode with custom arguments
        browser = await pw.chromium.launch(
            headless=True,
            args=[
                "--window-size=1280,720",
                "--disable-dev-shm-usage",
                "--ipc=host",
                "--single-process"
            ],
        )

        # Create a new browser context (like an incognito window)
        context = await browser.new_context()
        # Wider default timeout to match the agent's DOM-stability budget;
        # auto-waiting Playwright APIs (expect, locator.wait_for) inherit this.
        context.set_default_timeout(15000)

        # Open a new page in the browser context
        page = await context.new_page()

        # Interact with the page elements to simulate user flow
        # -> navigate
        await page.goto("http://localhost:8000")
        try:
            await page.wait_for_load_state("domcontentloaded", timeout=5000)
        except Exception:
            pass
        
        # -> Open the privacy policy page by navigating to /kebijakan-privasi and verify that the privacy policy content (the 'Kebijakan Privasi' text/content) is displayed.
        await page.goto("http://localhost:8000/kebijakan-privasi")
        try:
            await page.wait_for_load_state("domcontentloaded", timeout=5000)
        except Exception:
            pass
        
        # -> Click the '← Kembali ke Beranda' link to return to the landing page and verify the landing page is displayed.
        # ← Kembali ke Beranda link
        elem = page.get_by_role('link', name='← Kembali ke Beranda', exact=True)
        await elem.click(timeout=10000)
        
        # --> Assertions to verify final state
        
        # --> Verify the landing page is displayed
        await page.locator("xpath=/html/body/nav/div/a").nth(0).scroll_into_view_if_needed()
        # Assert: The site logo link is visible, indicating the landing page is displayed.
        await expect(page.locator("xpath=/html/body/nav/div/a").nth(0)).to_be_visible(timeout=15000), "The site logo link is visible, indicating the landing page is displayed."
        # Assert: The browser is on the landing page URL.
        await expect(page).to_have_url(re.compile("http://localhost:8000/"), timeout=15000), "The browser is on the landing page URL."
        current_url = await page.evaluate("() => window.location.href")
        # Assert: page loaded with a URL (final outcome verified by the AI judge during the run)
        assert current_url, 'Page should have loaded with a URL'
        await asyncio.sleep(5)

    finally:
        if context:
            await context.close()
        if browser:
            await browser.close()
        if pw:
            await pw.stop()

asyncio.run(run_test())

title: TC016-Show authentication error for incorrect password
description: This verifies that a visitor who enters valid-looking credentials with an incorrect password sees an authentication error message.
code:
import asyncio
import re
from playwright import async_api
from playwright.async_api import expect

async def run_test():
    pw = None
    browser = None
    context = None

    try:
        # Start a Playwright session in asynchronous mode
        pw = await async_api.async_playwright().start()

        # Launch a Chromium browser in headless mode with custom arguments
        browser = await pw.chromium.launch(
            headless=True,
            args=[
                "--window-size=1280,720",
                "--disable-dev-shm-usage",
                "--ipc=host",
                "--single-process"
            ],
        )

        # Create a new browser context (like an incognito window)
        context = await browser.new_context()
        # Wider default timeout to match the agent's DOM-stability budget;
        # auto-waiting Playwright APIs (expect, locator.wait_for) inherit this.
        context.set_default_timeout(15000)

        # Open a new page in the browser context
        page = await context.new_page()

        # Interact with the page elements to simulate user flow
        # -> navigate
        await page.goto("http://localhost:8000")
        try:
            await page.wait_for_load_state("domcontentloaded", timeout=5000)
        except Exception:
            pass
        
        # -> Click the 'Masuk' link in the top navigation to open the sign-in page.
        # Masuk link
        elem = page.get_by_text('Coba gratis', exact=True).locator("xpath=ancestor-or-self::*[.//a][1]").get_by_role('link', name='Masuk', exact=True)
        await elem.click(timeout=10000)
        
        # -> Fill the 'Email address' field with example@gmail.com, fill the 'Password' field with an incorrect password, and click the 'Sign in' button to submit the form.
        # email field
        elem = page.locator('[id="form.email"]')
        await elem.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=10000)
        await elem.fill("example@gmail.com")
        
        # -> Fill the 'Email address' field with example@gmail.com, fill the 'Password' field with an incorrect password, and click the 'Sign in' button to submit the form.
        # password field
        elem = page.locator('[id="form.password"]')
        await elem.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=10000)
        await elem.fill("wrongpassword123")
        
        # -> Fill the 'Email address' field with example@gmail.com, fill the 'Password' field with an incorrect password, and click the 'Sign in' button to submit the form.
        # Sign in button
        elem = page.get_by_role('button', name='Sign in', exact=True)
        await elem.click(timeout=10000)
        
        # --> Assertions to verify final state
        
        # --> Verify an authentication error message is displayed
        # Assert: The authentication error 'These credentials do not match our records.' is displayed.
        await expect(page.locator("xpath=/html/body/div[1]/div/main/div/div[1]/div/div[1]/div/form/div[1]/div/div/div/div[2]/div/div/div[2]/div/div[2]/div").nth(0)).to_have_text("These credentials do not match our records.", timeout=15000), "The authentication error 'These credentials do not match our records.' is displayed."
        await asyncio.sleep(5)

    finally:
        if context:
            await context.close()
        if browser:
            await browser.close()
        if pw:
            await pw.stop()

asyncio.run(run_test())
